_comment: Session Time Budget Estimator — cost model.
EDIT THIS FILE to recalibrate. Never edit the code to change a number.
Durations are minutes as [min, mode, max] and sampled beta-PERT, so `mode`
is the honest most-likely value, NOT the midpoint. Push `mode` toward `max`
for things that overrun (story beats) and toward `min` for things that
usually go fast (loot pickups).
`p` is the probability the tile actually costs `event` time rather than
`pass` time. It is 1.0 for everything except random_battle (see below) and
dirt (skill-check gated).

session._comment: Defaults; a plan file may override any of these.

_comment: Correlated whole-night speed multiplier, applied to CONTENT minutes only.
Right-skewed on purpose: sessions run long far more often than short.
Overheads are inelastic and are not multiplied by this.

overheads._comment: Inelastic minutes. Not scaled by tempo.

postBattleTail.note: per TRIGGERED battle: roulette, level-up, healing

break._comment: auto rule: 1 break once content passes `firstAt`, 2 once past `secondAt`

_comment: P(battle) is NOT the configured random_battle_percentage. dp-random-battle.js
runs a pity chain (miss: +20..30 pts, hit: halve, floored at
minimum_encounter_percentage) which converges to ~47% regardless of the
configured base rate. Verified by 2M-step Monte Carlo:
Raise this only if you also raise minimum_encounter_percentage above ~25.
Keys are DP.TILE_TYPES from dp-constants.js, plus name-based fallbacks for
tiles that exist as templates but have no TILE_TYPES entry.
TRAP: `rare_monster` is NOT in TILE_TYPES and infers as UNKNOWN in
dp-tile-state.js — a scene reader must match it by name or it prices a
34-minute tile at zero.
Warn when story-class tiles exceed this share of content minutes.
narrativeBeatsPerSession: a session wants EXACTLY one Story or Final Story
tile. Zero is a boring night (no plot revealed); two overshoots the window.
Rare Monster is story-CLASS in cost but is not a narrative beat.
